title: Why was this changed?
note: Tapping a tidy-up (the underline or its row) says what kind of fix it was, shows the exact words said and the tidied version, and offers to put it back.
text: Hear it Close Asha · 7 months Read it back We only fixed what got in the way of your words. Nothing added. Asha, um, today you you held the spoon by yourself. You mostly painted your face with it, but you were so so proud. I want you to know that I was too. Took out a sound You said um or uh. We took it out. You said " um, " Taken out Put it back Close With small fixes Exactly as said 2 small fixes Change words Private letters stay with you. You can add them to the book later.
